## ALL APPROVED WORK AND CONSTRAINTS
### P0 — PokeMMO accuracy + Synergy-style Pokédex
- The owner's newest rule is **"same mons as Synergy"**: default **browse catalog of base Pokémon AND alternate forms**, following Synergy's public species/form coverage and generation-grouped dense sprite layout, search/filters, scroll and stable form keys. Synergy page was observed near **731 entries** on 22 Nov 2026; **731 includes forms**, it is NOT 731 unique national species, PokeMMO owners/catchable entries or a stable eternal count. Preserve 649 base National reference IDs as canonical species; compare exact (species_id,form_key) sets, not just total count.
- Do NOT default to invented 644 list or interpret the user's in-game Seen `436/604` and Owned `216/603` as universal. Differ independently: catalog display, in-game Dex membership, acquisition (wild/perma raid/event/temporary/roamer/storyline), Seen/Owned/OT/Alpha/Shiny/Costume eligibility and personal manual states. Include accurate form-specific info or unknown.
- **Fix Virizion #640** (Feb 2026 permanent raid evidence), review Cobalion/Terrakion, Keldeo, Genies, Meloetta, Heatran/Cresselia, KoTH/story legendaries; source/version/date regression fixtures. Don't label every legendary unavailable or claim owner registered all species. Never invent encounter odds.
- Better summary hierarchy, PokeMMO's relevant Summary/Stats/Moves/Locations/Evolution/Type-matchups taxonomy, silhouettes only when user's manual registration supports it, favourite/notes/forms links.
- Basic factual catalogue should work without requiring a raw dump every time; original client sprites/dumps remain **private**. Safe optional one-time local detection/import with consent and preservation of original PokeMMO Flatpak/game files. Do **not** copy Synergy's site dataset, branding, code, private API or unlicensed artwork, nor distribute PokeMMO client assets in public GitHub.

### P1 — Useful PokeMMO calculators, not filler
- **REMOVE Damage Calculator from user-facing Companion** for now (navigation, Quick Access, menus, dashboard, popouts, stale links). Do not remove shared internals needed by other tools.
- Avoid noisy generic Experimental/Verified badges on tools with researched/tested formulas; identify uncertainty per unsupported record. Genuine unfinished/unresearched work can be labelled experimental or disabled with reason.
- **Breeding**: functional Parent A | Offspring | Parent B, consumptive parents, species/gender/egg groups, IV braces/nature/Everstone/egg moves as verified. Standard 5x31+nature plan: **32 starting parents / 31 breeding operations**; source-tested tree math, no "all verified" inference on hidden abilities/shiny/Alpha/costumes. **Fixed baseline price estimates**, manual optional overrides only; **NO live GTL** pricing requirement or provider layer.
- **Catch calculator**: current PokeMMO-specific capture formula and condition-dependent balls; current HP/max, status, species/form catch rate, special conditions, Alpha only if sourced. Lickitung 30 Oct 2026 catch rate `75` fixture; realistic rounding/estimates and source proof; do not promise exact if unverified.
- **Stat calculator**: actual PokeMMO Gen III+ stats with natures, IV/EV, floors, Shedinja, validated base stats/forms, level 50/100. EV per stat 252, total 510.
- **EV/horde planner**: correct yields/3/5-horde math and regions/time/season, verified Macho Brace/Training Link specifics, current encounter source dates (July 2026 encounter update). No generic Pokérus/power-item assumption and no invented rates. User does not need to manually validate every calculator; Claude performs research and automated golden tests.

### P1 — NEW user-approved Websites & Keyboard Shortcuts
- **Tools > Websites / Links**: real add/edit/reorder/delete/favourite/search of locally saved external bookmarks, Quick Access pin; seed editable PokeMMO Forums, official website, Support, **Synergy**, **PokeMMO Hub**. Never silently restore deleted defaults. Open validated `https://` destinations in the **default external browser**, NOT embedded, scraped or treated as API. Reject unsafe URL protocols and escape labels.
- **Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts**: assign/record/rebind/clear/reset; stable action IDs and conflict warnings. Default global hotkeys **OFF**, action scope based on focused Companion window, safe KDE Wayland fallback. No game keyboard interception/automation. Storyline current-step **toggle complete**, **next**, **previous**, optional show/hide Guide popout. Current character/run and region MUST remain correct; text inputs/dialogs suppress shortcuts; no key auto-repeat double toggles. Add functional shortcuts to other tools only where action implemented.
- Shortcut setting should be accessible in-tools where useful; all settings synced/persisted.

### Hard NO / exclusions
- **NO PokeMMO Hub API integration**, no market prices/chart/watchlist/GTL feed, no data-mirroring/provider abstraction. Hub is allowed as ordinary external bookmark and non-copied research comparator only. A credit line is NOT permission to redistribute data/assets.
- **NO Encounter Counter**, because the game has one. **NO Damage Calculator** (for this phase).
- NO client memory reading, injection, packet interception, macros/botting, game input automation, reverse engineering, default OCR/continuous capture.
- Do not bundle original ROMs, proprietary client dumps/images, unlicensed Synergy/site assets, copyrighted walkthroughs or user's private screenshots in public GitHub.
- Keep Theme Creator and ROM Patch Manager separate; don't merge them into Companion without a future explicit owner decision.
- Android and opt-in optical route/battle recognition remain **after stable 1.0** and require separate PokeMMO policy/privacy feasibility decisions. Default capture off.
